verdict_summary: The implementation reproduces the frozen bytes, the pinned universe and every byte pin exactly, and its Layer-A parity construction is structurally sound. It nevertheless FAILS this node's four acceptance criteria. Criterion 2 fails and trips a STOP CONDITION. Criterion 3 fails outright: zero of the slate's 34 carded kill diagnostics is a receipted output of the planned run. Criterion 4 fails by MEASUREMENT: the P22 guard, invoked with the only prohibited basis its module supplies, passes a design containing the current game's realized final margin. Separately, five of seventeen elements are built under a lambda-selection rule that is not the carded rule, and the deviation flips an arm-killing kill condition.

design_B_same_plus_three_deliberate_real.reading: THE GUARD PASSES A DESIGN CONTAINING THE CURRENT GAME'S REALIZED FINAL MARGIN. Measured |r| of the realized margin against every duration quantity is 0.033-0.038; against overtime it is 0.038. No partition test, no affine test and no collinearity test can fire, because the prohibited basis is the wrong quantity.

measurement_that_establishes_it.conclusion: The guard's DEPENDENCY BATTERY is sound and discriminates score surrogates correctly - but only when the caller supplies a score prohibited basis. The P22 module supplies no such constructor: realised_duration_basis is its only basis builder. Fitness for purpose on SCORE surrogates therefore depends entirely on a score prohibited basis that does not exist in the program. Until one is built and byte-pinned, no per-column P22 pass may be cited as evidence about score leakage.

The alternative reading - that the fitted column itself is used - appears unimplementable as frozen, reportedly because of 188 structural NaN with no declared imputation. ROUTED_ITEM_RULING.RULING: THE IMPLEMENTATION'S CHOSEN READING IS CORRECT AND IS NOT A DEVIATION FROM THE FROZEN CARDS. There is, however, NO CONTRADICTION between two frozen fields: the cards resolve the question explicitly in their own text, and both the implementation's characterisation of the item as a contradiction and the ground it gave for its reading are wrong. A separate, real defect sits underneath it - the receipt the same cards mandate for this column has no emitter.
ROUTED_ITEM_RULING.no_stop_condition: This ruling changes no estimand, no K0 structure, no inference structure, no universe, no cutoff-valid feature-set entry and no leakage status. It reads a frozen card as written. It is therefore ruled here rather than raised.

evidence_5_was_the_fitted_reading_really.routed_claim: the fitted-column reading appears unimplementable as frozen because of 188 structural NaN with no declared imputation
evidence_5_was_the_fitted_reading_really.ruling: OVERSTATED, AND IT IS NOT THE OPERATIVE GROUND. All 188 NaN rows are in season 2021, which is a TRAINING season in every one of the five folds and is never a test season. So the NaN never touch an evaluation row: they would break only the fold-train fits. Whether that makes the fitted reading 'unimplementable' depends on whether a row-drop or an imputation is admissible - and a row drop is barred independently (coverage_predicate is TRUE with no trimming; the strictly-prior row base is pinned; retention is measured at 100% on both denominators). So the fitted reading IS blocked, but by the coverage rule plus the absence of a declared imputation, not by NaN alone. This distinction matters: 'the card forbids the alternative' and 'the card is silent and the alternative is awkward' are different epistemic positions, and only the first is a safe basis for an implementation choice.
evidence_5_was_the_fitted_reading_really.the_operative_ground: The card's own companion_components and missing_value_handling sentences settle it directly. The implementation reached the right answer without citing the sentence that gives it.

ROUTED_ITEM_RULING.consequence_this_ruling_exposes: Because composite_p_home IS a carried ingredient rather than dead weight, the card's obligation attached to it is live: 'the sealed run receipts mean |p_model - p_home| agreement on non-NaN rows as a non-gating integrity diagnostic', binding on SC01::E3, SC06::E3 and SC08::E3, arm side and K0 side. No emitter for that quantity exists in S36. R_SC08_FLOOR is a DIFFERENT receipt (a Brier-vs-Brier floor comparison between two control objects) and does not discharge it. See FINDING B2.
ROUTED_ITEM_RULING.what_the_implementation_should_have_reco: Not 'a contradiction between two frozen fields, raised not resolved', but: 'the card routes composite_p_home to companion_components and states it is not in the prediction path; implemented accordingly; the mean-agreement receipt the same field mandates is owed at S38 and is not implemented here.'

findings.title: The lambda-selection loss is not the carded loss, on 5 of 17 elements, and the deviation flips an arm-killing kill condition
findings.card_says: SC01 (all three elements), k0_matched[...].arm_spec.comparison_gate_sidespec.penalty_treatment and the byte-identical k0_spec field: 'lambda selected per fold from the pinned grid {2, 8, 32, 128} by the pinned train-tail rule (fit ratings over the first 80% of the fold's training window by date, score the strength-feature head's SQUARED ERROR on the last 20% of training rows, argmin, then refit on the full training window)'. SC10 (both elements): 'lambda per fold from the pinned grid {4, 16, 64} by the same pinned train-tail rule as SC01 (fit on first 80% of training window by date, score head SQUARED ERROR on last 20%, argmin, refit)'.
findings.code_does: arms/sc01_opp_adj_interacting.py line 132, inside _strength.fit_and_score: 'return float(np.mean(np.abs(tgt[tail] - X[tail] @ f.coef)))' - MEAN ABSOLUTE ERROR. arms/sc10_form_trend.py line 115, inside _build.fit_and_score: 'return float(np.mean(np.abs(y[tail] - X[tail] @ f.coef)))' - MEAN ABSOLUTE ERROR. arms/_head.py::select_lambda_train_tail names them 'training-tail MAE values' in its own docstring, so the choice is consistent and deliberate, not a typo.
findings.why_it_is_severity_A: penalty_treatment and shrinkage_regularization are two of the seventeen machine dimensions the cards declare matched_identically_for_arm_and_k0, and every affected card stamps estimation_objective.s36_deviation_consequence = 'ANY_PER_ARM_DEVIATION_DISCOVERED_AT_S36_VOIDS_THE_ARM'. The selected lambda is not cosmetic: for SC01 it determines the ridge rating fit and therefore the VALUES of the treatment column itself; for SC10 it is the shrinkage applied to the two spread coefficients the kill is stated on.

measured_consequence.method: the node's own selection rule was run twice per (element, fold) - once scoring the train tail by mean absolute error (as coded) and once by mean squared error (as carded). Only the SELECTED LAMBDA is reported; the selection scores are construction-time quantities and are not emitted.
measured_consequence.the_kill_flip: SC01's kill condition 2 is 'shrinkage collapse: the pinned selection rule drives lambda to the grid maximum in >= 4 of 5 folds', scope 'kills the arm'. Counting grid-maximum (128) selections: under the CODED rule, SC01::E3 selects 128 in 5 of 5 folds and SC01::E2 in 4 of 5 - the kill's threshold is met on both. Under the CARDED rule, SC01::E3 selects 128 in 1 of 5 folds and SC01::E2 in 4 of 5. The coded rule therefore fires an ARM-KILLING kill on SC01::E3 that the carded rule does not. This is a count of selected construction constants, not a performance comparison.

findings.what_would_have_to_change: Change both fit_and_score closures to return the mean SQUARED error on the train tail, exactly as the two cards' penalty_treatment strings state. Nothing else. The tie-break rule (smaller lambda) and the 80/20 chronological split are correctly implemented and are unaffected.

findings.title: SC08's frozen estimation objective is not implemented in the fit path; the planned run would fit a Bernoulli logit instead
findings.card_says: SC08_SIGMA_MARGIN_MAP::E3_HOME_WIN_PROB, estimation_objective.training_loss = 'gaussian_mle_on_train_margin_residuals_for_dispersion_parameters_only__mean_path_frozen_before_dispersion_fit'; response_family = 'gaussian_probit_margin_map'; link_function = 'probit margin map: p = Phi(mu_hat / sigma_hat); mu_hat = per-fold train-OLS affine map of composite_pred_margin, frozen before any dispersion fit'; null_construction.method = 'parameter_fixed_at_null' (gamma1 = gamma2 = 0). matched_identically_for_arm_and_k0 = true, s36_deviation_consequence = ANY_PER_ARM_DEVIATION_DISCOVERED_AT_S36_VOIDS_THE_ARM.
findings.code_does: runner/runner.py lines 150-153, _fit_side: 'if estimand == "E3_HOME_WIN_PROB": return fit_logit_irls(X, y, cols); return fit_ols(X, y, cols)'. The branch is on the ESTIMAND only. There is no branch on arm_id, on DesignPair.comparison ('parameter_fixed_at_null'), or on anything else. run_element (line 193) therefore fits SC08's design [intercept, composite_pred_margin, sigma_z_pace_prior, sigma_z_lagged_margin_sd] as a Bernoulli-logit against the 0/1 win indicator, and _predict (line 158) applies the logistic, not Phi(mu_hat/sigma_hat). The mean map is not frozen before anything; there is no mu_hat and no sigma_hat.
findings.the_correct_estimators_exist_but_are_dea: estimators.fit_dispersion_newton and estimators.sigma_from_dispersion implement the carded Newton dispersion fit correctly (pinned init log sigma0 at the train residual sd, gammas 0, tol 1e-10, expected information Hessian). A repository search for their names over the whole node returns exactly three call sites, all in tests/TESTS.py (lines 443, 446, 448). No production path calls either.
consequences: SC08's element is fitted under the wrong response family and the wrong link, voiding the arm by its own card clause.

All three SC08 kills need sigma_hat and cannot be evaluated: dispersion-spread inertness (p90/p10 of predicted sd_margin), fictitious variance signal (slope of squared residuals on sigma_hat^2), calibration harm (the 10-bin table).

The mu-frozen identification the card registers - 'mean and dispersion trade off in a probability-only fit, so only the sigma parameters are free' - is destroyed: a logit fit gives the mean path free coefficients.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: run_element must dispatch on the element, not on the estimand: for SC08, fit mu_hat by train-OLS on composite_pred_margin, freeze it, fit sigma parameters by fit_dispersion_newton on the train margin residuals (Z of width 2 for the arm, width 0 for the K0), predict p = Phi(mu_hat/sigma_hat) and clip to [0.001, 0.999].

findings.title: SC10's carded ridge penalty is never applied at fit time; the planned run would fit both elements unpenalised
findings.card_says: SC10_FORM_TREND::E1_GAME_TOTAL and ::E2_FINAL_MARGIN_HOME, penalty_treatment: 'ridge (prior mean 0) on the two spread coefficients only, lambda per fold from the pinned grid {4, 16, 64} ... intercept and null-granted coefficient unpenalized; K0 has no penalized terms'. estimation_objective.shrinkage_regularization = 'ridge on spread coefficients per penalty_treatment; none elsewhere'.
findings.code_does: arms/sc10_form_trend.py uses fit_ols(..., ridge=lam, penalise=[F,F,T,T]) ONLY inside the lambda-SELECTION closure (line 114). The returned DesignPair carries the selected lambda in fold_constants['lambda_selection'] and the names in fold_constants['ridge_applies_to'], but DesignPair has no field a fitter reads for a penalty. runner/runner.py::_fit_side calls fit_ols(X, y, cols) with the default ridge=0.0 and no penalise mask. A repository search for 'ridge=' over the node finds exactly two non-test call sites: sc01's rating fit and sc10's selection closure. Neither is the head fit run_element performs.
findings.why_it_is_severity_A: The head coefficients c1 and c2 the planned run would produce are unpenalised OLS coefficients, not the carded ridge coefficients. penalty_treatment and shrinkage_regularization are declared matched dimensions with the VOIDS_THE_ARM clause. SC10's kill 1 - 'spread-block emptiness: 95% train-refit CI for every spread coefficient covers 0 in >= 4 of 5 folds' - is stated on coefficients that would not be the carded ones.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: DesignPair must carry the penalty (lambda + penalise mask) so the fitter can honour it, and _fit_side must apply it to both sides. Note the card's 'K0 has no penalized terms' means the identical rule touches an empty set on the K0 side, which fit_ols already supports via the mask.

findings.title: No train-refit bootstrap exists anywhere in the node; the B=2,000 stream is declared and never consumed
findings.card_says: SPEC_V2.inference and S35 frozen_inference_configuration: B_train_refit = 2000, 'one stream per fold, shared by arm and its null', for coefficient intervals. Five kills are stated on train-refit coefficient CIs: SC02 kill 2 ('sealed per-fold coefficient table with B=2,000 train-refit CIs'), SC03 kill 2 (same), SC04 kill 1 ('sealed coefficient table (pooled + per fold, train-refit CIs)'), SC10 kill 1 ('95% train-refit CI for every spread coefficient'), SC11 kill 1 ('sealed coefficient table' with the card's pooled+per-fold CI reading).
findings.code_does: runner_constants.B_TRAIN_REFIT = 2000 and SEED_PURPOSE_TRAIN = 'train_refit' exist. seed_manifest.py derives and digests the train_refit stream. runner.run_element accepts b_train, stores it in the receipt as 'b_train_refit', passes it to seed_manifest.build_manifest - and never draws from it. The only bootstrap loop in the node is the test-side delta loop at runner.py lines 204-207, which uses SEED_PURPOSE_TEST. A repository search for 'SEED_PURPOSE_TRAIN' finds it only in runner_constants and seed_manifest; no resampling code consumes it.
findings.second_defect_in_the_same_place: cluster_bootstrap.na_draw_rule implements the K7 symmetric NA rule correctly and is called ONLY from tests/TESTS.py lines 383-386. runner.py's module docstring lists as guarantee 5: 'Symmetric NA -- a failed refit or a constant indicator on either side voids the draw for BOTH.' run_element performs no refit inside the bootstrap (it resamples fixed predictions) and never checks whether a declared indicator column - SC06's ERA2024 is the slate's only one - is constant on a resampled draw. The guarantee as written is not implemented.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Implement the train-refit bootstrap: for each of B=2,000 draws of the fold's TRAINING clusters, refit arm and K0 on the resampled training rows, collect coefficients, and take percentile 95% intervals - applying na_draw_rule symmetrically so a draw that fails on either side is NA for both.

findings.title: No pooled out-of-fold surface is computed; the primary gate's first clause has no object
findings.card_says: S30 section 3: 'Pooled out-of-fold is the primary evaluation surface; per-fold results reported.' S35 primary_gate_per_element.a: 'pooled OOF improvement > 0 against the element's own K0_MATCHED'. Every card's comparison_gate_sidespec.evaluation_rows: 'pooled OOF over the five folds is the primary surface'.
findings.code_does: run_element loops folds and, inside each fold, bootstraps that fold's test clusters. per_fold[fid] carries delta_ci95 and two_sided_p for that fold alone. There is no pooling step, no pooled cluster set, no pooled bootstrap and no pooled delta anywhere in the node.
findings.consequence: The primary gate clause (a) cannot be evaluated, and the ~15 kills stated on pooled Delta cannot fire. A per-fold interval is not a pooled interval and the two are not interchangeable.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Add a pooled surface: concatenate the five folds' out-of-fold predictions over the 1,286 pooled test clusters and bootstrap the pooled cluster set, with the paired-by-derivation seed discipline the per-fold loop already gets right.

findings.title: Zero of the slate's 34 kill diagnostics is a receipted output of the planned run
findings.card_says: S30 section 4(c), carried verbatim into S35: 'every kill's diagnostic must be a receipted output of the sealed run (an uncheckable kill is a card defect)'. This audit's third acceptance criterion restates it.
findings.code_does: See .acceptance_criterion_3_kill_diagnostics.per_kill_census for all 34, one line each. ElementSpec.mandatory_receipts is a tuple of STRINGS on every element; the strings name receipts that no code produces. tests/TESTS.py checks that the strings are present, not that the objects can be built. Three receipt WRAPPERS exist (sc06.era_split_receipt, sc11.cross_estimand_receipt, sc08.r_sc08_floor_receipt); each takes the number it labels as a caller-supplied argument.
findings.what_the_node_DID_build_that_is_genuinel: runner/verify_carded_strata.py re-derives every carded kill STRATUM from the node's own feature code and every census reproduces (SC01 472 pooled with the 75/76/74/81/92 test-season split and 74 in 2021; the rejected min-reading 516; SC02 249; SC03 399; SC12 652 high-bite). That establishes the kills' SUBSETS are correctly defined and non-empty. It does not establish that any kill's DIAGNOSTIC exists.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Each of the 34 kills needs an emitter that produces its named object, and the runner needs the three missing machineries A4 (train-refit CIs), A5 (pooled surface) and A2 (SC08's sigma path) before most of them are even expressible.

findings.title: P22 postgame_surrogate_guard is not fit for purpose on SCORE surrogates, measured, and S36 never invokes it
findings.card_says: S30 section 1 requires this audit to 'verify P22's guard is fit for purpose on score surrogates (its cycle-1 tests target duration/minutes surrogates) before relying on it per-column'. Every one of the 11 frozen arm blocks carries p22_guard_obligation: 'every column listed in features_lineage[].sources[].columns with classification != PRESENT_IN_ARTIFACT_NEVER_READ_BY_ANY_ARM passes the P22 postgame_surrogate_guard invocation at S37, per column, with S37 first verifying the guard is fit for purpose on SCORE surrogates.'
findings.code_does: S36 contains no import of and no call to postgame_surrogate_guard. The obligation text is present in runner/obligations.py and RUNNER_MANIFEST.json; the mechanism is not.
findings.measured_verdict_on_fitness: MEASURED NOT FIT FOR PURPOSE AS SUPPLIED. Invoked with the only prohibited basis the P22 module can construct (realised_duration_basis: game_minutes / overtime_periods / is_overtime / team_minutes), the guard returned passed=True and zero blocking findings on a design that contained the current game's realized final margin, a scaled current-game total, and the current game's home points. The same guard, given an auditor-constructed score prohibited basis, returned passed=False with 12 blocking findings naming exactly those three columns and no others. Full numbers in .acceptance_criterion_4_p22_fit_for_purpose.
findings.so_the_defect_is_not_the_battery: The dependency battery discriminates correctly. The module supplies no SCORE prohibited-basis constructor, and a guard audited without the right basis is, in the guard's own words, a design that 'has not been shown to be free of one'.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Build and byte-pin a score prohibited basis (at minimum the current game's realized home points, away points, total, margin and settled win indicator, aligned row-for-row with the audited frame), add it to the P22 module as a first-class constructor beside realised_duration_basis, and invoke the guard per column on both the arm and the K0 design of all 17 elements. Note this must be done at the CALL SITE per GRAPH_POLICY - the frozen guard module may not be edited except by the node that owns it.

findings.title: The current-game-deletion invariance receipt at COLUMN grain was never produced
findings.card_says: S30 section 1: 'every arm ships a current-game-deletion invariance receipt, scoped at column grain ... The receipt recomputes the feature matrix with the current game's rows retained only with the identity columns intact and every other column nulled, in every consumed source; byte-identity of the two matrices proves no same-game realized information entered the prediction path.' S35 what_this_freeze_authorises.AUTHORISED names 'the deletion-invariance receipt at column grain' among the receipts S36 is authorised to emit. S35 downstream_obligations.O7 binds 'S36 (receipt runs at COLUMN grain), S37 (audits the classification per column)'.
findings.code_does: No such receipt exists in S36. The obligation is discharged in RUNNER_MANIFEST.json by naming tests/TESTS.py::t_o7, which reads SPEC_V2.json and checks the CARDS' classification strings against each other. It nulls nothing, builds no second feature matrix, and compares no bytes.
findings.why_it_matters: S30 section 1 says in terms why source-grain retention proves nothing: master_team.parquet carries settled scores on the same rows as schedule identity, and score_baseline_rows.parquet carries actual_total, actual_margin and y_home_win on the same rows as the null-granted composite columns. The column-grain receipt is the ONLY artifact that turns 'no same-game realized information entered' from an adjective into a measurement, and it does not exist.
findings.what_this_audit_did_instead: Measured the underlying property directly on a 24-game sample across 28 feature columns by perturbing each sampled game's OWN outcome rows and re-deriving. Byte identity held everywhere; zero violations. That is a positive result and it is genuine, but it is a sample, it covers only master_team's outcome columns, and it is not the receipt. See .acceptance_criterion_4_p22_fit_for_purpose.current_game_deletion_invariance_at_COLUMN_grain.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Emit the receipt: build each element's arm and K0 feature matrix twice - once normally, once with every consumed source's non-retained columns nulled on the current game's rows - and pin the byte identity of the two matrices, per element, per fold.

findings.title: STOP CONDITION RAISED: twelve CUTOFF_UNPROVEN fields are consumed by retained arms without a receipted cutoff-validity measurement
findings.statement: See .acceptance_criterion_2_cutoff_unproven_receipts in full. S30 section 8 binds an UNPROVEN field used by any arm to a receipted cutoff-validity measurement in this audit. The D10/F13 inventory rules 37 fields CUTOFF_UNPROVEN. This node measured 13 of them to be consumed by retained arms. Exactly one - master_team.game_date - carries such a measurement, and this node re-ran it byte-for-byte. The other twelve carry classifications, byte pins and provenance arguments; the D10 ledger's own rule says 'structural plausibility is never a substitute'.
findings.why_it_is_HALTED_not_RESOLVED: Promoting any of the twelve, declining to promote them, or ruling that S30 section 1's schedule-identity admission subsumes section 8 for the six master_team schedule columns would each CHANGE THE CUTOFF-VALID FEATURE SET. S30 section 11 and this node's own stop condition make that a HALT-and-raise, not a node-internal resolution.
what_the_coordinator_must_decide: Whether S30 section 1's closed schedule-identity set discharges section 8 for game_id, season, season_type, is_home and opp_team_id - and if so, why S33R commissioned M_A1_GAME_DATE_CUTOFF_V2 for a member of that same set.

Whether SC06's tz component may consume team_cities.venue_iana_timezone (D10 #18) and the derived shift_from_prev_venue_hours (D10 #22) on an IMMUTABLE_REFERENCE_METADATA classification alone, given the ledger's explicit refusal to accept time-invariance arguments in place of timestamps.

Whether SC08 may consume projected_team_off_possessions on a construction receipt (which attests construction ORDER) where the ledger requires observation TIME - the case the ledger itself calls 'the sharpest in the ledger of the difference between validated and timestamped'.
Whether the five score_baseline_rows prediction columns, which postdate the inventory entirely, need a cutoff-validity measurement of their own.

findings.title: SC06's fatigue index uses a career-length previous-game clock where the card specifies a same-season clock; 19 game clusters carry a different treatment value, and the choice is undeclared
findings.card_says: SC06_SCHED_FATIGUE_DIFF::E2 and ::E3, preprocessing (both sides, byte-identical): 'F = 1.0*1[back-to-back: previous SAME-SEASON resolved-universe game exactly 1 day earlier] + 0.5*1[3rd game in 4 days: second-prior SAME-SEASON game within 3 days] + 0.25*min(tz_crossed, 3); tz_crossed = |standard UTC offset of current venue tz - standard UTC offset of PREVIOUS-GAME venue tz| ... previous game undefined -> F = 0 (max rest, card-declared convention, not a row drop)'.
findings.code_does: arms/sc06_sched_fatigue_diff.py::fatigue_index groups by 'team_id' ALONE (lines 91-92 and 103), not by (team_id, season). The 'previous game undefined' test at line 108 is prev1.isna(), which is true only at a team's first game in the whole 2021-2026 row base. At every SEASON opener from 2022 onward the previous game is the previous SEASON's last game, so the tz component is computed across the off-season.

measured_consequence.note_on_those_values: all are pure tz contributions (0.25 x 1, 2 or 3 zones); the two rest components correctly evaluate to zero across an off-season gap, so the defect is confined to the travel term
measured_consequence.effect_on_the_kill_stratum: the |F_H - F_A| >= 1 subset count is 71 under BOTH readings (per test season 7/8/17/28/10 identically), so SC06's affected-subset kill retains the same habitat under either reading

findings.why_B_not_A: The card's same-season qualifier is attached explicitly to the two rest components and only implicitly to the tz term, so the reading is genuinely ambiguous rather than plainly contradicted. The defect is that the choice was made silently: S36's own interpretive-pin disclosure for SC06 covers only the standard-offset tz map, not the cross-season previous-game clock, so a reader has no way to know an interpretation was taken.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Either group by (team_id, season) so a season opener takes F = 0 per the card's 'previous game undefined' convention, or declare the career-clock reading explicitly as an interpretive pin with this measured consequence attached.

findings.title: The card-mandated mean |p_model - p_home| agreement receipt has no emitter on any of the three E3 elements
findings.card_says: SC01::E3, SC06::E3 and SC08::E3, companion_components (arm side and K0 side, byte-identical): '... composite_p_home carried as a null-granted anchor column NOT in the prediction path - the sealed run receipts mean |p_model - p_home| agreement on non-NaN rows as a non-gating integrity diagnostic; identical treatment on both sides'. SC01::E3's notes additionally name it: 'the sealed run receipts the K0-vs-frozen-p_home Brier agreement so the structural claim is checked rather than asserted.'
findings.code_does: No function in the node computes a mean absolute difference between a model probability and p_home. sc08.r_sc08_floor_receipt is a different object: it compares the Brier of SC08's K0 probability path against the Brier of the p_home column, and it correctly takes no challenger argument. The universe frame does carry C_p_home (runner/universe.py line 117) and the receipt counts its 188 NaN (line 196), so the ingredient is present; nothing consumes it.
findings.why_it_matters: This is the receipt that makes composite_p_home a carried ingredient rather than an unused declaration. This audit's ruling on the routed contradiction turns on the card's statement that the column is carried and receipted; without the emitter, the anchor reading is correct on paper and inert in practice.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Add an emitter that computes mean |p_model - p_home| over non-NaN p_home rows, for arm and K0 separately, on all three E3 elements, and add it to those elements' mandatory_receipts.

findings.title: SC06's A1-SENSITIVITY kill cannot fire: the enumerated exception set is never read by any code
findings.card_says: SC06 kill_conditions[3]: 'A1-SENSITIVITY: removing the enumerated game_date exception clusters (10 release-order displaced + 6 without a second-endpoint witness, listed in a1_game_date_cutoff_promotion.enumerated_exception_set) flips the SIGN of the affected-subset Delta - a rest/travel result that depends on clusters whose scheduling is in question is not a result', scope 'kills the arm'. Receipted diagnostic: 'R-A1-EXCEPTIONS: sealed exception-removed Delta table on the identical universe string for arm and K0'. S35 O6 binds S36 to emit it on EVERY element.
findings.code_does: 'R-A1-EXCEPTIONS' appears in the node only as a literal string inside ElementSpec.mandatory_receipts on all 17 elements, and tests/TESTS.py::t_o6 asserts the string is present. No code reads SPEC_V2.a1_game_date_cutoff_promotion.replacement_measurement_registered.enumerated_exception_set, no code holds the 16 game_ids, and no exception-removed universe is constructed.
findings.auditor_note: The exception set itself is sound - this node re-ran M_A1_GAME_DATE_CUTOFF_V2 and reproduced 10 release-order displaced clusters and 6 clusters unwitnessed by the second endpoint, byte-for-byte. The defect is that nothing downstream consumes it.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Load the 16 enumerated game_ids from the frozen SPEC_V2 block, build the exception-removed universe string, and emit the exception-removed Delta table for arm and K0 on every element - non-gating on 16 of them, arm-killing on SC06.

findings.title: SC12's pinned spread-ranking statistic is not implemented, so its third kill has no defined subject
findings.card_says: SC12 kill_conditions[2]: 'outliers-are-signal confirmation: Delta negative in the two widest-strength-spread test seasons while positive elsewhere - kill rather than universe-shop. Train-observable split, PINNED: for each fold, spread statistic = variance across teams of final training-window season-to-date net ratings; the two folds with the largest statistic are the widest seasons (deterministic, train-only, no outcome data of the test season)'.
findings.code_does: arms/sc12_robust_input_winsor.py carries the kill as a string (KILLS[2]) and names the receipt 'season_split_delta_table_with_spread_ranking' in mandatory_receipts. No function anywhere in the node computes a variance across teams of season-to-date net ratings, or ranks folds by it.
findings.why_it_matters: The card went out of its way to pin this statistic deterministically and train-only precisely so the 'widest seasons' could not be chosen after seeing results. Leaving it unimplemented reopens exactly the discretion the pin closed.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Implement the statistic as pinned, emit the per-fold ranking as a receipt before any Delta is computed, and derive the two 'widest' folds from it.

findings.title: SC10's orthogonalised sealed variant is half-built: the covariate exists, the variant design and its Delta do not
findings.card_says: SC10 kill_conditions[1]: 'schedule confounding: pooled Delta <= 0 once the spread block is orthogonalized against the trailing-opponent-strength differential (declared sealed variant; the covariate is registered with full lineage, byte-pinned source, support floor and per-column P22 obligation in this arm's features_lineage - S34 finding B4)', receipted diagnostic 'sealed orthogonalized-variant Delta receipt', scope 'kills the arm'.
findings.code_does: arms/sc10_form_trend.py::trailing_opponent_strength_diff builds the covariate correctly and build() correctly keeps it out of the primary head - which is exactly right and makes the 'sealed-variant only' clause checkable. But no orthogonalised design is constructed (no residualisation of the two spread columns against the covariate) and no variant Delta is computed.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Build the orthogonalised variant design pair - spread block residualised on the covariate using train-only coefficients - and emit its Delta receipt.

findings.title: SC06's timezone offset map carries a seventh zone the card does not enumerate, contradicting the module's own fail-closed claim
findings.card_says: SC06 preprocessing pins the map explicitly: 'IANA zones mapped to pinned standard offsets: New_York -5, Indiana/Indianapolis -5, Toronto -5, Chicago -6, Phoenix -7, Los_Angeles -8' - six zones.
findings.code_does: arms/sc06_sched_fatigue_diff.py lines 68-70 define STANDARD_OFFSETS with SEVEN entries, adding 'America/Denver': -7. The module comment immediately above (lines 61-65) states the map 'covers EXACTLY the six IANA zones present in the byte-pinned team_cities.csv ... enumerated rather than defaulted so that a new franchise in a seventh zone fails closed instead of being silently assigned an offset'.
findings.measured: data/reference/team_cities.csv (16 rows, pinned at 10a544fd...) contains exactly six distinct zones: America/Chicago, America/Indiana/Indianapolis, America/Los_Angeles, America/New_York, America/Phoenix, America/Toronto. America/Denver is absent, so the extra entry changes no current value.
findings.why_it_is_still_a_finding: The fail-closed guarantee the comment claims is weaker than stated: a Denver franchise would be silently admitted rather than raising. And the code disagrees with the card's enumerated map and with its own comment.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Delete the America/Denver entry so the map is the carded six, or declare the addition.

findings.title: runner.py's stated guarantee 5 (symmetric NA) is not implemented in the code it describes
findings.detail: runner/runner.py module docstring, 'WHAT THE RUNNER GUARANTEES, in the order it enforces them', item 5: 'Symmetric NA -- a failed refit or a constant indicator on either side voids the draw for BOTH.' run_element's bootstrap loop (lines 204-207) resamples fixed predictions, performs no refit, and never inspects dp.indicator_cols on a resampled draw. cluster_bootstrap.na_draw_rule implements the rule correctly but is called only from tests. Folded into finding A4's second half; recorded separately because a docstring that overstates an enforced invariant is the class of defect this program has repeatedly paid for.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: Either implement the rule in run_element or reword the guarantee to describe what the code does.

findings.title: The base closed set implemented at S36 has seven members; S30 section 1 enumerates four and does not name season_type
findings.card_says: S30 section 1: 'schedule-identity is a closed, enumerated set of columns - scheduled game date, opponent/matchup identity, home/away designation, season - extendable only by S34 adjudication'. SPEC_V2.schedule_identity_set_extension_s34_adjudicated.base_closed_set_unchanged restates exactly those four.
findings.code_does: runner/obligations.py lines 134-135: O7_BASE_CLOSED_SET = ('game_id', 'season', 'season_type', 'game_date', 'team_id', 'opp_team_id', 'is_home'). tests/TESTS.py::t_o7 asserts the cards' SCHEDULE_IDENTITY_S30_SECTION_1 columns are a subset of that seven plus 'method'.
findings.assessment: game_id, team_id and opp_team_id are fairly read as 'opponent/matchup identity' plus the join key. season_type is not one of the four and is not in the S34-adjudicated extension list either. It is classified SCHEDULE_IDENTITY_S30_SECTION_1 on the frozen cards, so this is a card-level widening that S36 inherited rather than introduced.
findings.why_it_is_C_and_not_raised_as_a_stop_con: season_type is carried into the game frame by runner/universe.py::build_universe but this node found no arm feature that reads it, so nothing in the current slate turns on it. If a later reviewer rejects the classification, the affected element set is readable from the current_game_row_consumed flags exactly as O7 intended. Recorded because 'the closed set is closed' is load-bearing and a silent seventh member erodes it.
findings.adjacency_warning: if a future element consumes season_type this becomes a cutoff-valid-feature-set question and therefore a stop condition.

findings.title: SC09 has no design on the real universe, so 1 of 17 elements is unaudited for parity and 3 of 34 kills are unbuildable at this node
findings.detail: DESIGN_PARITY_RECEIPT.json carries 16 elements and skips SC09_FAV_GAP_COMPRESSION::E2_FINAL_MARGIN_HOME. The cause is a property of the frozen card, not of the implementation: SC09's treatment feature h = sign(g_hat)*max(0, |g_hat| - 8) is a transform of the element's OWN FITTED K0 prediction, and fitting is not authorised before this audit passes. The implementation handled this well - build() takes g_hat as a keyword argument so S38 can hand it the same K0 it is already fitting, and no second differently-fitted g_hat can exist. Two residual notes: (1) runner.run_element calls spec.build(universe, fold, cache) positionally, so g_hat defaults to None and sc09.k0_prediction refits internally - functionally the same fit, but it defeats the design's own safeguard and should be wired explicitly at S38; (2) SC09's habitat kill ('the |g_hat| > 8 subset is < 10% of pooled test clusters') is the one carded habitat census that verify_carded_strata.py could not re-derive, so unlike every other kill in the slate its subset is not yet known to be non-empty.
findings.what_would_have_to_change: At S38, pass the fold's fitted K0 prediction to build() explicitly, and emit the |g_hat| > 8 subset count as the first SC09 receipt.

carried_disclosures_this_audit_independe.item: the slate-wide EWMA convention is unstated on every card; the RECURSIVE form (pandas adjust=False) is the only one that reproduces SC12's carded habitat numbers
carried_disclosures_this_audit_independe.s37_verification: re-derived at this node: with adjust=False and the support floor NOT applied, |w_H - w_A| >= 2.0 gives 652 pooled clusters, 97/118/102/141/107 per test season, 87 in 2021, median 1.703982, p90 4.705777, max 13.0 - matching the card's seven figures to the last printed digit.
carried_disclosures_this_audit_independe.residual_note: the convention is applied uniformly to SC04, SC10, SC11 and SC12. Only SC12 carries numbers that pin it; for the other three it is an inference, correctly disclosed.

carried_disclosures_this_audit_independe.item: SC12's carded habitat reproduces only with the >= 3 prior-games support floor NOT applied, while the same card's parameters make the floor normative; the implementation builds the normative reading and reports both
carried_disclosures_this_audit_independe.s37_verification: re-derived at this node: floor applied gives 649 pooled (85 in 2021, 97/118/102/140/107 per test season), median 1.699105, p90 4.679514, max 12.65564. Both readings leave the bite-concentration habitat non-empty in every fold and both leave the integrity p90 roughly 4.7x its 1.0 threshold, so neither SC12 kill changes behaviour.

what_this_audit_could_NOT_establish: Whether the twelve unreceipted CUTOFF_UNPROVEN fields are in fact cutoff-valid. Establishing that would change the cutoff-valid feature set and is a stop condition (finding A9). The audit measured the gap and stopped.

Exhaustive current-game-deletion invariance. This node sampled 24 of 1,491 clusters across 28 feature columns and found zero violations. That is evidence, not the receipt S30 section 1 requires (finding A8).

Whether the score_baseline_rows prediction columns are cutoff-valid. Their provenance argument cites build_score_baselines.py line numbers; this node did not re-derive the composite columns from their own inputs, only confirmed that the frozen column digests reproduce.
Whether SC09's habitat kill can fire. Its subset is defined by a fitted quantity and fitting is not authorised here; it is the only carded habitat census in the slate whose non-emptiness is unknown.

Whether the arm_registry.jsonl append the S35 freeze specifies has been performed correctly. That is the coordinator's byte-identity proof and lies outside this node's scope; this audit did not open the registry.
pipeline_id remains asserted-not-demonstrated, as S35 recorded. This audit did not close the frozen comparison_gate's own documented open gap.

Whether the 17 machine dimensions of comparison_gate.py are satisfied dimension-by-dimension by the built designs. This audit checked the dimensions the cards vary (penalty_treatment, link_function, estimation_objective, companion_components, missing_value_handling, calibration_freedom, preprocessing) and found the three deviations recorded as A1, A2 and A3; it did not run comparison_gate.LAYER_A_STRICT itself, because the frozen gate operates on fitted side-specs and no fit is authorised.

items.why: S30 section 8's promotion requirement, applied to the twelve consumed CUTOFF_UNPROVEN fields that carry no measurement, would CHANGE THE CUTOFF-VALID FEATURE SET whichever way it is decided. S30 section 11 makes that a HALT.
items.action_taken: HALTED AND RAISED. Not resolved inside this node.

stop_conditions.explicitly_not_tripped_by_the_routed_rul: The ruling on composite_p_home reads a frozen card as written and changes no estimand, no K0 structure, no inference structure, no universe, no cutoff-valid feature-set entry and no leakage status.

prohibitions_honoured.no_performance_number_emitted: No MAE, Brier, accuracy, log-loss, Delta or arm-vs-null comparison appears anywhere in this output. The only numbers emitted are counts, censuses, hashes, NaN counts, cluster counts, correlation coefficients between a deliberately-constructed leak column and a duration basis (a leakage diagnostic, not a model metric), and SELECTED LAMBDA values, which are construction constants pinned by the card's own grid. The lambda-selection SCORES were computed in memory as the card's construction rule requires and are not emitted, exactly as S36's own redaction rule states.
prohibitions_honoured.no_fit_on_real_data_for_evaluation: The only fits this node ran on real rows were (a) SC01's ridge rating construction and (b) the train-tail selection fits, both of which are FEATURE CONSTRUCTION steps the cards mandate and neither of which touches a test cluster. No arm and no K0 head was fitted for evaluation and no out-of-fold prediction was scored.
prohibitions_honoured.sealed_results_not_read: No file under experiments/player_program/stage2b/SEALED_RESULTS or experiments/player_program/stage3_score/SEALED_RESULTS was opened. One repository-wide grep returned paths under stage2b/SEALED_RESULTS in its file list; none was read and no further search touched those trees.

recommendation_to_the_coordinator.gate_decision: DO NOT AUTHORISE FITTING. S35 states that fitting requires a PASSED S37 implementation audit; this audit returns FAIL.
ordering: 1. Resolve stop condition A9 first. It is a contract-interpretation question and it governs whether several arms may consume their inputs at all; every other repair is wasted if the answer narrows the feature set.
2. Then repair A1, A2 and A3 - the three card-vs-code deviations that void arms by the cards' own clause. They are small, local and unambiguous.
3. Then build the three missing machineries A4 (train-refit bootstrap), A5 (pooled OOF surface) and A2's sigma path, because most kill diagnostics are not expressible without them.
4. Then discharge A6 kill by kill against the per-kill census in this file, A7 (score prohibited basis + per-column invocation) and A8 (the column-grain deletion receipt).
5. B1-B5 and C1-C4 can be repaired alongside; none of them blocks the others.
recommendation_to_the_coordinator.erratum_discipline: None of these repairs may edit the frozen cards. S35 what_this_freeze_authorises.NOT_AUTHORISED_EDITS: any defect discovered downstream is handled by a NEW registry-appended erratum or amendment record naming the defective field. Findings A1, A2 and A3 are CODE defects and need no erratum - the cards are right and the code is wrong. Finding B1's ambiguity and finding C3's season_type classification are CARD-side and would need erratum records if a reading is to be pinned.
